objective: Process 1: To calculate the average MAD of every crossdock part over the range of months set in the system master and to set the part status in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: Active when the average MAD is equal to or above Min MAD, Inactive when it is below.

Process 2: To create the new calculation period of Mapping per Destination and split the Max Case/Day of every Active part over its destinations in proportion to the actual demand (MAD) of each destination (buyer code + PD code) over the range of months set in the system master.
Each process is all-or-nothing and is retried automatically up to 3 times; after that it can be started manually from the Cross Dock Part Master screen (XD01).

extra_tables.title: Execution Schedule
rows: Monthly scheduler (set in the system master; not detailed in this document). One run = process 1, then process 2.
A failed process is retried automatically up to 3 times; process 2 starts only after process 1 has succeeded.

[Run calculation (Part List)] on XD01 runs process 1 and then process 2; [Run calculation (Mapping)] on XD01 runs process 2 only. Each button is enabled only when its process and the 3 retries have failed.
One date per process in the Log; process 1 shown on the Part List tab, process 2 on the Mapping per Destination tab.
Runs after XD04. If XD04 failed, XD05 still runs (with the actual demand data available in NSP) (decided 19-Oct).

nodes.label: Save new period, Sync Status, history

steps: Process 1 (part status) starts from the scheduler, an automatic retry, or [Run calculation (Part List)] on XD01.

steps.text: Get the range of months N from the system master.
children: MONTH_TO = month before the run month; MONTH_FROM = N months back. Example: run in Oct 2026, N = 6 -> 202604 to 202609.

steps.text: Select every part of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (Candidate, Active and Inactive).
children: Skip a part whose EFFECTIVE_START_DATE is after the run date (not calculated yet).

steps.text: For each selected part, read TB_R_ACTUAL_DEMAND_SUMMARY rows of the part within the range and calculate (see 4.1):
children: TOTAL_MAD = sum of MAD of all buyer code / PD code / order type (N + S) rows in the range.
AVG_MAD = TOTAL_MAD / N. The divisor is always N; a month without data counts as 0.

steps.text: Compare AVG_MAD with MIN_MAD of the part (see 4.2):
children: AVG_MAD >= MIN_MAD -> Active.
AVG_MAD < MIN_MAD -> Inactive.
Insert one result record per calculated part into TB_R_PART_DAD_RESULT.
When the calculated status differs from the current one: update PART_STATUS in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and insert a history record (event CALC, source BATCH).

steps: Check whether any error occurred during steps 2 to 6.
No error: commit process 1, record SUCCESS of process 1 in the Log (END_DT = last success date). Continue with step 10 (process 2).

steps.text: Error: roll back process 1, record FAILED in the Log; process 2 is not started.
children: The scheduler retries automatically up to 3 times. After the 3rd failed retry, [Run calculation (Part List)] is enabled on XD01. Exit.

steps: Process 2 (destination mapping) starts after process 1 has succeeded, from an automatic retry of process 2, or [Run calculation (Mapping)] on XD01 (process 2 only). It uses the part status just set by process 1.

steps.text: Get the range of months N from the system master; the new period = run month.
children: Example: run in Oct 2026, N = 6 -> months 202604 to 202609, new period 202610.

steps: Select every part of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE with PART_STATUS = Active.

steps.text: For each part, read TB_R_ACTUAL_DEMAND_SUMMARY rows within the range and group them by GROUPING_BUYER_CD + GROUPING_PD_CD:
children: Destination code = GROUPING_BUYER_CD + GROUPING_PD_CD (7 digits, e.g. 9722D + 10 = 9722D10).
Result MAD = sum of MAD of the group (order types N + S). Groups with result MAD 0 are not used.
A part without any result MAD gets no destination (listed with Total Case/Day 0 on the screen).

steps.text: Check every destination code in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (DESTINATION_CD).
children: Not found: error -> go to step 19 (all-or-nothing).
Sort the destinations by result MAD, largest first, and keep at most Max Case/Day destinations.
Target = result MAD / sum of result MAD of the kept destinations x Max Case/Day.
Round down with a minimum of 1; adjust so the total equals Max Case/Day.

steps.text: Save the new period in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST (see 4.7):
children: Delete the rows of the new period if they exist (manual re-run), then insert the calculated rows.
A part whose mapping differs from the previous period: SYNC_STATUS = 0 (No Sync) and a history record per added / changed / removed destination (event MAPPING, source BATCH).

steps: Check whether any error occurred during steps 11 to 16.
No error: commit, record SUCCESS in the Log (END_DT = last success date). The new period becomes the ongoing period; the previous period becomes past (read only). Exit.

steps.text: Error: roll back process 2, record FAILED of process 2 in the Log.
children: The scheduler retries process 2 automatically up to 3 times. After the 3rd failed retry, [Run calculation (Mapping)] is enabled on XD01. Process 1 stays committed. Exit.

func_desc.text: One batch with two processes run in sequence: process 1 sets the part status from the average MAD (4.1 - 4.4); process 2 creates the destination mapping of the new period for the Active parts (4.5 - 4.8). Range of months and schedule are set in the system master (not explained in this document).

items: Range: the N months before the run month (N from the system master). Example: run in Oct 2026 with N = 6 -> 202604 to 202609.
Monthly MAD of a part = sum of MAD of all its rows in that month (all buyer codes, PD codes and order types N + S).
AVG_MAD = total MAD of the range / N. The divisor is always N, whatever the data: a month without data counts as 0.
A part without any demand row in the range gets AVG_MAD = 0.
AVG_MAD is kept with 2 decimals and compared as it is (no rounding).
Possible changes: Candidate -> Active / Inactive, Inactive -> Active, Active -> Inactive.
Parts whose EFFECTIVE_START_DATE is after the run date are not calculated.
The batch may overwrite a status changed manually by the user. The user may still change the status again afterwards by screen or upload.
One record per calculated part is inserted into TB_R_PART_DAD_RESULT (also when the status does not change).
Only parts whose status changes are updated in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE (PART_STATUS, LAST_SOURCE = CALC, CHANGED_BY / CHANGED_DT) and get a history record (event CALC, source BATCH).

SYNC_STATUS: a part that changes from Active to Inactive gets SYNC_STATUS = 0 (No Sync), so the next [Sync] deletes it in GTOPAS (XD06, RPA, all rows) and in AP POLE (XD07, SFTP file, part level) (decided 30-Oct). Other status changes do not change SYNC_STATUS.
All-or-nothing: any error rolls back the whole run.
A failed run is retried automatically up to 3 times by the scheduler (RUN_TYPE = RETRY, RETRY_NO 1-3 in the Log).
After the 3rd failed retry, [Run calculation] is enabled on the Part List tab of XD01 (RUN_TYPE = MANUAL).
The last success date (END_DT of the latest SUCCESS record in the Log) is shown on the Part List tab of XD01.
Only Active parts of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE are calculated.
Range: the N months before the run month (N from the system master).
Destination code = GROUPING_BUYER_CD + GROUPING_PD_CD (7 digits). It must exist in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION; otherwise the run fails (all-or-nothing).
Result MAD = sum of MAD of the part for that destination within the range; order types N and S are summed. Destinations with result MAD 0 are not used.
Sort the destinations of the part by result MAD, largest first.
Keep at most Max Case/Day destinations (the ones with the largest result MAD); the others are not mapped.
Target = result MAD / sum of result MAD of the kept destinations x Max Case/Day. Same as the corrected formula of the simulation file: P10 / SUM(P10:P13) x N10 with fixed ranges.
Case/Day = target rounded down, with a minimum of 1 per destination.
While the total is below Max Case/Day: +1 to the destination with the largest fraction (equal fraction: higher result MAD first).
While the total is above Max Case/Day (because of the minimum 1): -1 from the destination with the smallest fraction that still has more than 1 case.
Result: every kept destination has at least 1 case and the total equals Max Case/Day.
The new period = run month. On a manual re-run in the same month, the rows of that period are replaced.
After a successful run the new period is the ongoing period; the previous period becomes past (read only).

Each part is compared with its mapping of the previous period. When destinations or Case/Day differ: SYNC_STATUS = 0 (No Sync), LAST_SOURCE = CALC, and a history record per added / changed / removed destination (event MAPPING, source BATCH). When equal: no update and no history.
An Active part without result MAD has no row in the new period; the D/S user assigns it on the screen or by upload.
All-or-nothing: any error rolls back the whole run; the previous period stays the ongoing period.
The batch has its own scheduler (system master). A failed run is retried automatically up to 3 times (RUN_TYPE = RETRY, RETRY_NO 1-3 in the Log).
After the 3rd failed retry, [Run calculation] is enabled on the Mapping per Destination tab of XD01 (RUN_TYPE = MANUAL).
The last success date (END_DT of the latest SUCCESS record in the Log) is shown on the Mapping per Destination tab of XD01.

sample_sheet.title: Sample Input
sample_sheet.heading: Sample calculation - DAD Volume Calculation (process 1 and process 2)
intro: Process 1: Run in Oct 2026 with range = 6 months (system master) -> months 202604 to 202609, divisor 6.
Process 1: Monthly MAD of a part = sum of MAD of all buyer code / PD code / order type (N + S) rows of the part in that month (TB_R_ACTUAL_DEMAND_SUMMARY).
Process 2: Run in Oct 2026 with range = 6 months (system master) -> months 202604 to 202609; new period = 202610.
Process 2: Result MAD of a destination = sum of MAD of the part for that buyer code + PD code (order types N + S) within the range (TB_R_ACTUAL_DEMAND_SUMMARY).
Process 2: Target = result MAD / sum of result MAD of the destinations used x Max Case/Day.

rows: 515.08 >= 500 -> Active. History CALC/BATCH. Sync Status not changed.

rows: Rounded down 2 each = 8; 2 left go +1 to the first two (equal fraction: higher result MAD / rank first).

Rounded down with min 1 = 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 7 > 5: take 1 from the destination with the smallest fraction that still has more than 1 case (repeat).
